mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_log (study_id, user_id, title, content) VALUES (#{studyId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE study_log SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT sl.id, sl.study_id, sl.user_id, u.nickname AS writer_nickname, sl.title, sl.content, sl.created_at, sl.modified_at FROM study_log sl INNER JOIN user u ON sl.user_id = u.id WHERE sl.study_id = #{studyId} ORDER BY sl.created_at DESC
